_about: ENG35 (2026-11-07, owner 20:58: "Fuse skills together. For example, Almanac number and grant are the same ... It's just a matter of parameter choice"). One skill per idea. A family's skill key holds its value in one of three shapes: true (the default), a plain value (number, list or name: the skill's own parameter, as before), or a small object of named parameters {v, <param>...}: v is the plain value (left out when it is the default true; null when the card has no base value, only a part), and each other name is one parameter listed in params. Examples: "almanac": 4 (N); "almanac": {"v": 4, "gives": {"evasive": true}} (N and its braces); "nocturnal": {"v": 2, "hp": 1} (+2/+1 at night). params maps each parameter name to the engine's internal key (the old twin key, e.g. gives -> almanacGrant): bramblewood-skillparams.js expands the object into those keys when cards are read (the engine, the budget, the build), and tools/fold_skill_params_2026_11_07.py folds old twin keys into the object. Old twin keys still read everywhere (cloud overrides, saved decks, the hub): the alias map is built from params. default / number / stat / ability are documentation, shown in the Map cards window's skill tooltip and the workbook: what plain true means, the plain value's default, an example of the stat version and of the ability version (skills in braces).

fields.gives: the braces: skills and/or stats it has (Name - {...})
fields.who: which units count: kin / any (Esprit); ally (Harbinger); any / yours / foes (Carnage); yours / theirs (Throng); weakest / random (Heal)
fields.res: the resource delivered or gained (Delivery: res; Felling: metal = Prospector)
fields.bramble: aims the shot at the enemy bramble
fields.poison: the shot carries the unit's Poison
fields.bleed: the shot carries the unit's Bleed
fields.armor: Armor it has while its Shield lasts
fields.kind: a named version of the skill: its own rule and price (the old skill it replaces)
fields.lasts: how long it lasts: a round (default); lasting = for good; washed = until washed off
fields.swings: never = it never swings, it only shoots (Archer)
fields.sees: what it senses through: dark = darkness only (Darksight); default also Blind, Fog, Shadow
fields.hold: how it holds: full = the target does nothing (Constrict); bind = Bound only, no squeeze (Tangleweed)
fields.shots: true = its shots act twice too (Double Time)
fields.stat: the stat it grows: hp = Health (Spoils)
fields.range: how far it counts allies: 2 = within 2 slots (Sociable); default adjacent
fields.type: the shot's damage type: fire, ice, acid, poison, shock (default: a plain arrow, physical)
fields.form: bolt = a bolt (Speed 1, before the rest swing); default an arrow (Speed 0, after the swings)
fields.every: round = it delivers every round it is Ready (Delivery every round); default once

_aboutKinds: ENG39 (2026-11-09, owner decision DES2-3 a): a family may list kinds, its named versions: {"<selector>": {"<value>": "<old key>"}}. On a card the old skill is written as the family key with the selector, e.g. "daunt": {"v": 1, "lasts": "lasting"} (was "weaken": 1), "carnage": {"v": 5, "who": "any"} (was "requiem": 5); a kind that is itself a family keeps its parts ("arrow": {"v": 3, "swings": "never", "style": "drop"}). A kind named by two selectors at once is listed in "kindSets": [{"match": {"type": "fire", "form": "bolt"}, "key": "fireBolt"}]. Expanding gives back the old key, so its rule and its price are unchanged; old keys still read. A card that holds two versions of one family keeps the second as its old key.
